user.title: Rolling door
user.description: Pick the door open/close sensor (a contact binary_sensor, or a cover) and the notification service. If the sensor reads backwards (shows 'Open' when the door is shut), turn on 'Invert state'.

data.alert_minutes: Alert when open longer than (minutes, 0 = off)

init.title: Rolling door settings
init.description: Change the sensor, notification channel, alert thresholds and message texts. Messages accept these variables (wrapped in curly braces): time, date, duration.

data.alert_minutes: Alert when open longer than (minutes, 0 = off)
